summary: Computes a rolling 32-bit hash over a null-terminated string and returns the hash reduced modulo a caller-supplied divisor. Walks the string character by character, folding each character through helper sub_58B465 into an accumulator using the fixed multiplier 1664117991, and terminates at the null terminator.

operations.description: Initialize the accumulator v3 to 0, load the string base pointer v2 from *a1 and read the first character v5 from **a1.
When the first character v5 is non-zero, enter the character-walking hash loop.
do { ++v2; ...; v5 = *v2; } while (*v2); — advance one character per iteration and stop at the null terminator.
Fold the current character through sub_58B465 into the rolling hash: v3 = sub_58B465(v5) - 1664117991 * v3, using the fixed multiplier 1664117991.
Return v3 % a2, the final hash reduced modulo the caller-supplied divisor a2.
